Class MatchedPathVariables

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.bind.MatchedPathVariables
All Implemented Interfaces:
NamedValues, PathVariables
Direct Known Subclasses:
RoutePathVariables
@Internal public class MatchedPathVariables extends Object implements PathVariables
The PathVariables of the variable values of a matched route, converted with a conversion service like the PathVariable arguments of a controller method: a value of a List type is split the same way.

A missing variable fails with the exception of unsatisfied(String, Argument), which the router overrides to fail with its own, and a value that does not convert with a ConversionErrorException, both answered with 400.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
